journey.title: Start a new Money Ledger
journey.purpose: A new operator understands the empty system, creates the minimum accounting structure, and records the first event without mistaking an undefined position for zero.

steps.intent: Understand that no books or events exist and position is undefined
Create the first book and account
Choose manual entry because no source adapter is configured
Record the first event and see its provenance and basis
Read the first position from the journal
